slice: Compose the workflow artifact manifest gate into the exact-commit observation pipeline.

fail_closed_conditions: artifact belongs to another workflow run
behavior.accepted_artifact_projection: Only names from a verified manifest are forwarded to the observation gate.

verification.method: Fetched the committed dependency closure and executed the Node test suite in an isolated local runtime.

deployment_claim: No Vercel deployment or browser audibility is claimed by this operations-only slice.
rollback: Revert the pipeline import and artifact_manifest stage; the standalone manifest gate and previous observation gate remain intact.
constraints_preserved: No payment or conversion logic added to Vercel.
No GitHub files or history deleted.
No peer execution claimed without evidence.
